english_text: on behalf of the S&D Group . - Mr President , our thoughts today are with the people of Haiti in their tragedy , and I am sure all Members will want to send their condolences to the people of Haiti . It is a tragedy but , as Gay Mitchell has said , it is a tragedy in a country where 75 % of people already live below the poverty line . As we look to the future , that is something we really need to be looking at . The public has responded magnificently to the challenge of helping Haiti . High Representative , I want to thank you for the work you have done in pulling together a quick EU response on this matter . We learned at the time of the tsunami that , in fact , good coordination is as important as the actual funds we put on the ground . It is not about which flag goes on the aid , it is about getting the aid out there , working with the United Nations to get it delivered . Looking to the longer term , I am pleased that there will be an international conference on Haiti . I think we need to look at the whole issue of Haiti , about its outstanding debt , and I hope the debt problems of Haiti will be on the agenda at the international conference . Haiti owes USD 890 million to the international creditors and a large part of that is to the IMF . The IMF has given Haiti a USD 100 million loan . Can we convert that into a grant ? I hope as well that we will address other issues , and I think you are right that the issue of the border with the Dominican Republic is equally important . So , thank you once again for your efforts , and I hope the whole House will work hard to find a good coordinated effort .
